Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — closure playbook & outstanding legal items

Hi Laura / Acme team —

Quick weekly MAP checkpoint from our side. We're getting close on timing but want to align on a few blocking items so we can lock a signing date. Attached: Redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (action tracker) and MSA_redlines_annotated.pdf (our current suggestions).

Status highlights (short):
- MSA: Redwood redlines submitted. Primary open: Section 4.2 (indemnity), Section 7 (data residency language).
- Order form: Draft signed-off by sales; needs final PO number + signature from Acme.
- Vendor setup: Procurement portal onboarding requires W-9/Tax and vendor form. Marcus is owned on that from our side.
- Evaluation: We completed the pilot eval; minor perf notes surfaced (shared offline).

Action items (current):
1) Acme legal to confirm stance on 4.2 and data residency — owner: Acme Legal (Emma) — eta: 48h
2) Acme procurement to provide PO number or confirm DocuSign route — owner: Laura — eta: EOD Thu 5/6
3) Marcus to share vendor-portal invite + payment instructions once PO confirmed — owner: Marcus Lin — eta: after PO
4) Marissa (Redwood Legal) to review Acme questions and produce clean MSA for signature — owner: Marissa — eta: 24–48h

Proposed close timeline: target signature window 5/7–5/10 if legal and procurement items resolve this week. Can we confirm whether Acme can target 5/7 for signature?

Thanks — short call optional if it's helpful. I can host a 15-min sync tomorrow.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — closure playbook & outstanding legal items

Marissa — forwarding Acme's procurement note and their questions. Quick notes inline: 

> Can Redwood confirm where production data will be hosted (region/region fallback)?

We use multi-region with primary US regions (us-west-2) for this account; customer data can be pinned to US-only tenancy for this Dedicated deployment. Suggest adding explicit "data held in US" language with an operational fallback clause.

> We also need SOC 2 evidence and a DPA before PO issuance.

We have SOC 2 Type II report and a standard DPA; both are already in our compliance pack. I can attach the SOC 2 pointer and ping infra to generate the DPA template for Acme.

Karthik's proposed redline compromise for indemnity: limit broadly scoped mutual indemnity to third-party IP claims and gross negligence, keep cap at 2x fees for direct damages and carve out consequential exclusions. This should ease their legal team while protecting us.

Can you take a look and advise whether we can push to Acme's proposed language or if we need to counter? If Marissa is ok with the approach, we can push a clean MSA and ask Acme to sign by 5/7.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — closure playbook & outstanding legal items

Thanks for the context and the suggested compromise. I reviewed Karthik's proposed language and the annotations in MSA_redlines_annotated.pdf. High-level:

- Indemnity: acceptable to move to a third-party IP + gross negligence mutual indemnity and limit direct damages to 2x fees. We will preserve exclusion for consequential damages.
- Data residency: we can accept "data held in US regions" language for this Dedicated deployment; will add a fallback operational clause that any cross-border transfer requires prior customer consent.
- SOC 2 / DPA: confirm we will provide SOC 2 Type II pointer and a standard Redwood DPA. Neha — please attach the DPA template for the Acme review.

I'll produce a clean MSA (MSA_clean_v3.pdf attached) with these changes tracked accepted. I expect to have the final pull-ready MSA within 24 hours. Once Acme confirms PO/DocuSign, we can route for signature.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: MSA_clean_v3.pdf
